旧模型的权重已停止发布，历史验证结果不代表对具体整合包有效。新模型需要匹配模组版: Old model weights are no longer published. Historical validation does not establish accuracy for a specific modpack. The new model must match mod versions, combinations and game scenarios, and is still in development. These figures are not measurements of JVM heap or native memory and must not be used to block a launch.
